title: Backfill existing items and in-flight work onto content item lineages
description:
Feature: One-time content item backfill
  Scenario: Existing records join one content item each
    Given Items without a stage and reporting or copywriting Assignments without itemLineageId
    When an operator runs papyrus assignments backfill-content-items
    Then published Items get stage published and other Items get stage copywriting
    And a drafted reporting candidate adopts its draft's lineage
    And an undrafted reporting candidate gets a new content item at report or editor_select
    And copywriting work follows its draft or its reporting candidate
    And ambiguous cases are reported as warnings instead of guessed
